text.tspan: Q57 · Secrets: how they leak, how to stop it, what to do now
Git: history, forks; bots scan in minutes
Env vars in /proc/<pid>/environ; args in ps
IAM roles, OIDC, IRSA / Pod Identity,
IMDSv2, SSM instead of SSH keys
"It was in Git for 2 days and I deleted the commit. Safe?" → NO. Rotate it and check CloudTrail.
